title: Woman Sets Porta Potty On Fire Because She Doesn’t Like It
description:
On November 4, 2021, police were called to a local park after a woman was seen lighting a Porta potty on fire in La Crosse, WI. She lit toilet paper on fire, which caused a large flame to erupt and placed other items on top to keep the fire going. All because it was full of waste...
